title: Core Quartet #03
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, porcelain-pale skin, slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip, a serene expression, sultry, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic — a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: both hands framing her own face.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme cobalt thigh-high stiletto boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, a confident, luminous expression, cheerful, pure icy-white hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree — a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Left woman's footwear: extreme silver extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Jamaican woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, cool and composed, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern — a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: both hands framing her own face.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold sculptural heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Korean woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a poised, refined, confident expression, cheerful, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer — a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense jewel-toned scenework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
